subject: Dedicated commitment playbook — throughput targets & owners
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@arcadia.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated commitment playbook — throughput targets & owners

Hi Elena —

Great to meet last week. Following up with a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft for Arcadia's dedicated capacity commitment. Goal here is to align owners, define throughput targets we’ll validate during the evaluation window, and lock a close timeline so procurement has a path to PO/final signature.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30 min):
- Introductions & roles (5m)
- Workload & latency objectives (10m)
- Throughput targets & test harness (7m)
- Timeline, procurement steps, and next actions (8m)

Initial throughput targets (placeholder for discussion):
- Steady-state: 1,200 tokens/sec across the pooled capacity
- Burst target: 1,800 tokens/sec for 3–5 minute bursts
- Desired p50 latency: <120ms for 1k token prompts (model dependent)

Attachments: redwood_dedicated_playbook_v1.pdf (MAP draft), throughput_workbook.xlsx (sample run configs), MAP_timeline_Arcadia_v1.odt (milestones)

Proposed kickoff slots: Tue 2027-06-01 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 2027-06-02 14:00–14:30 PT. If those don’t work, tell me a window and we’ll accommodate.

Owners on our side:
- Dylan Brooks — Sales lead / overall MAP owner
- Marissa Cole — Solutions & evaluation plan lead (test harness)
- Monica Patel — Dedicated onboarding / capacity ops
- Priyom Das — Billing & commitment coordination

Can you confirm attendees from Arcadia (engineering + procurement) and preferred kickoff slot?

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@arcadia.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir.desai@arcadia.ai>, Procurement <procurement@arcadia.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated commitment playbook — throughput targets & owners

Thanks Dylan — this looks good and very helpful.

Attendees on our side:
- Elena Torres (Product lead)
- Samir Desai (ML infra lead)
- Priya Nair (SRE) — pending confirmation
- Procurement (procurement@arcadia.ai) — included on this thread

We’re aligned to validate at least the steady-state and burst numbers during a 2-week evaluation period. The p50 latency goal seems reasonable — Samir will bring the baseline numbers from our in-house tests so we can reconcile.

Kickoff: Wed 2027-06-02 14:00 PT works for us. Procurement will need the MAP doc and an initial commitment sketch to start internal approvals — happy to get that from you right after the call.

Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Product, Arcadia AI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated commitment playbook — throughput targets & owners

Thanks — quick internal note before the kickoff:

I’ll lead the evaluation plan and own the test harness. Action items for team:
- Marissa: prepare an evaluation script (k6 + custom request generator) and a run matrix (see attached throughput_workbook.xlsx)
- Monica: scope GPU pool config for the validation (proposed: 4 x H100 80GB equivalent nodes, NVLink enabled, persistent KV cache)
- Priyom: draft the commitment summary for procurement with month-by-month capacity and billing profile; include a 90-day rollback clause for first contract

Throughput assumptions we’ll validate in week 1:
- Single-node baseline: 300–350 tokens/sec (model: open-llama-65b-q4)
- Pool scaling: near-linear to hit ~1,200 tokens/sec at 4 nodes with our batching strategy

I’ll put the evaluation checklist in the shared Drive folder and post the link in the kickoff meeting notes.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Dedicated commitment playbook — throughput targets & owners

Thanks all — confirmed for Wed 2027-06-02 14:00 PT. Calendar invite just sent.

Quick pre-read items I’ll share before the call:
- MAP one-pager (redwood_dedicated_playbook_v1.pdf) — outlines owners, milestones, evaluation gates, and close timeline
- Throughput workbook (throughput_workbook.xlsx) — sample configs + expected scaling curves
- Draft commitment summary for procurement (short form)

Jumping items for the kickoff:
1) Finalize evaluation window (we recommend 10 business days)
2) Confirm exact models to test and prompt templates
3) Agree on success criteria for go/no-go (throughput + p50/p95 latency + error rate)
4) Procurement path & expected sign date (target: 2027-06-16)

After the call we’ll update the MAP timeline in the Drive and post a live HubSpot link to the deal record: https://hubspot.company/contacts/rdw-arc-2027-0529

See you on the call —
Dylan
